Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Finance flagged invoice INV-7482 for a resale certificate before we can apply tax-exempt treatment for the order. To move this fast, can you send a PA resale affidavit that meets our acceptance criteria below? If you can attach it to a reply, I’ll get finance to clear the hold ASAP.

Redwood acceptance checklist (PA resale):
- Buyer name and legal entity exactly as it appears on your billing/EIN records (no ambiguous DBAs)
- Buyer address in Pennsylvania
- Statement of purchase for resale (PA-specific language)
- Buyer’s PA sales tax license or EIN (EIN acceptable for companies without a PA ST-2 number)
- Valid signature (wet signature or DocuSign with audit trail) and date

If the form you send uses a DBA or slightly different company punctuation, we’ll need either: (a) a copy of the DBA registration, or (b) a corrected affidavit showing the legal entity name.

Attachments: sample template and list of required fields attached to this message for your convenience.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the fields.

Marissa from Finance here. Quick clarification on our acceptance policy so there’s no back-and-forth:

Minimum acceptable evidence (must include at least one of the following):
- Signed resale certificate naming the invoiced legal entity exactly (preferred), OR
- Signed resale certificate for a named DBA plus an official state filing that links the DBA to the invoiced entity (PDF of DBA registration or certificate), OR
- Signed letter on corporate letterhead from legal/tax counsel tying the two names together and showing EIN.

We also require:
- Signature (wet or DocuSign with audit trail)
- Effective date that covers the invoice date (INV-7482 dated 2027-08-02)
- A visible EIN or PA tax ID on the supporting document(s)

If you can upload the DBA_certificate_MidtownRetail.pdf or re-send a corrected affidavit that lists "Midtown Retail, Inc." as the buyer, we will clear the invoice hold within 24 hours of receipt. Please upload to the secure HubSpot file link or reply here with DocuSign completion URL.
